newsitem.title: USA: Owens Corning files $350mln shelf offering.
newsitem.headline: Owens Corning files $350mln shelf offering.

text.p: Owens Corning filed Thursday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission a shelf offering of up to $350 million in debt securities, preferred, common, warrants, stock purchase contracts, stock purchase units and subordinated debentures.
The Toledo-based glass manufacturer said proceeds from the sale will be used for general corporate purposes, including financing working capital needs and capital expenditures.
No underwriters were named in the shelf registration.
